title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: SAP Technical Lead
description:
About SEW

Smart Energy Water (SEW) is the leading provider of cloud-based digital platforms that empower global energy, water, and gas providers. Our innovative AI-, ML-, and IoT-powered solutions deliver world-class Customer Experience (CX) and Workforce Experience (WX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights:

  • 420+ global clients across the U.S., Europe, Canada, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees and growing rapidly
  • Millions of users engaged monthly
  • 150+ industry awards and global recognition from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, and LA Times


Searching for your dream job? We are a true global company that values building meaningful relationships and maintaining an enthusiastic work environment while fostering innovation and creativity. At SEW, we believe that everyone contributes to our success, and in return, we provide opportunities for them to learn new skills and build a rewarding professional career.


Summary

We are seeking a Senior SAP Technical Leader with deep expertise across SAP’s core and cloud platforms to design and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for utility enterprises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Service Cloud V2, and SAP IS-U
  • Architect clean core, upgrade-safe extensibility using ABAP, OData, RAP, and SAP-recommended extension frameworks
  • Define and execute integration strategies across SAP and non-SAP systems (APIs, events, middleware)
  • Design scalable, high-performance architectures that support enterprise and utility-specific requirements
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for complex initiatives, guiding development teams and solution partners
  • Ensure solutions align with SAP best practices, security standards, and long-term platform roadmaps
  • Optimize performance, reliability, and maintainability across the SAP landscape
  • Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions


Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ABAP
  • Strong expertise in OData services, REST APIs, and SAP integration patterns
  • Proven experience implementing clean core–compliant extensibility
  • Deep knowledge of SAP IS-U in utility enterprise environments
  • Experience with SAP Service Cloud V2 and SAP CX integrations
  • Solid understanding of SAP BTP, including extension, integration, and API management services
  • Strong background in system integration, performance tuning, and scalability
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and influence architectural decisions
  • Utility industry experience
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Fluency in Spanish is highly required

title: IT Risk Management Lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead


Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‑out, and continuous improvement of our client’s enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‑based frameworks and the organization’s ISMS.


You’ll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‑ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‑defined, tracked, and executed.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models

• Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment

• Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‑aligned controls

• Drive treatment planning, cross‑functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

• Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‑ready materials for leadership

• Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

• Champion automation and AI‑enabled workflows to improve program efficiency


Qualifications:

• 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity

• Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+ ) required

• Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them

• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF , SOC 2 , PCI, GDPR

• Hands‑on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies

• Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences

• Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)

Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.


About Clinergy

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.


Role Description

We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.


Activities

  • Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
  • Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
  • Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
  • Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
  • Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
  • Advanced/Fluent in English;
  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
  • Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices


Skills

  • Self driven individual
  • Sense of urgency
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Enthusiastic and energetic


To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to


Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

description:
Descrição da Empresa Santos e Silva Advocacia e Consultoria Jurídica é um escritório de advocacia localizado em Curitiba/PR. Com compromisso e excelência, oferecemos serviços jurídicos e consultoria de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Somos reconhecidos pelo profissionalismo e pelo foco em soluções jurídicas personalizadas. A empresa é movida por valores como ética, transparência e dedicação.

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.


Acreditamos que a inteligência artificial não substitui a criatividade, mas expande as possibilidades de quem cria.

Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde pessoas curiosas, inquietas e mão na massa podem explorar, testar, errar, aprender rápido e evoluir junto com o mercado (e junto com a gente).


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Criar ferramentas, automações e integrações com IA que melhorem o dia a dia dos nossos times;
  • Desenvolver workflows inteligentes para projetos criativos e campanhas;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com times criativos, estratégicos e de produto;
  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end SR (.Net)
description:
Há 10 anos no mercado, a V8.Tech é uma empresa jovem, movida por tecnologia e inovação, que acelera a transformação digital. Ajudamos nossos clientes a revolucionarem seus negócios por meio da reestruturação e evolução, com foco na otimização de processos, tecnologia da informação, transformação digital e no crescimento em diversos setores. Atendemos diversos países na América Latina a partir de nosso escritório em São Paulo: Argentina, Colômbia, Peru e México.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O profissional atuará na migração de códigos Java para .NET.
  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs baseadas em arquitetura hexagonal, garantindo a exposição de dados para diferentes clientes por meio de REST APIs e tópicos corporativos.
  • Atuar na evolução e modernização de aplicações legadas escritas em VB6, VB.NET e ASP.NET, integrando-as com novas soluções baseadas em .NET e microserviços.
  • Construir adapters, barramentos e camadas anticorruption (ACL) para interligar sistemas legados a novos serviços de forma segura e desacoplada.
  • Assegurar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, aplicando padrões como Arquitetura Hexagonal, DDD e Clean Architecture.
  • Implementar comunicação assíncrona e orientada a eventos, utilizando RabbitMQ para garantir resiliência e desacoplamento entre serviços e sistemas de dados.
  • Criar e otimizar queries SQL e NoSQL, garantindo eficiência e performance em ambientes com alto volume de dados, otimizando o processamento de workloads transacionais e analíticos.
  • Atuar na automação de testes e nos pipelines de CI/CD, promovendo qualidade, rastreabilidade e entregas contínuas.
  • Monitorar performance e identificar gargalos, assegurando respostas rápidas e escalabilidade do sistema.
  • Apoiar a squad na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos, garantindo alinhamento com a arquitetura do projeto.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de dados e integração com o Data Lake, possibilitando ingestão eficiente para uso por times de Data Science, BI e aplicações analíticas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de DevSecOps para promover segurança e governança do ambiente, assegurando conformidade, rastreabilidade e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Implementar estratégias de caching e otimização de latência, garantindo respostas rápidas para consumidores finais e sistemas analíticos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET Core e .NET Framework (C#).
  • Conhecimento prático em VB.NET ou VB6. (Diferencial).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Vivência com arquitetura hexagonal e padrões de mensageria.
  • Experiência com APIs REST e múltiplos modelos de entrega de dados, como mensageria e data marts.
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de infraestrutura utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade, tracing e logging distribuído.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e PL/SQL).
  • Sybase (Diferencial)
  • Capacidade de atuar em sistemas com alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Experiência prévia em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e colaboração em squads multidisciplinares.


Requisitos desejáveis


  • Experiência com design de APIs escaláveis para diferentes consumidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado em DataOps e integração de pipelines de dados.
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes e infraestrutura distribuída.
  • Experiência com event sourcing e padrões de mensageria avançados.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de data lakes e otimização de consumo para analytics
  • Conhecimentos de Java e orientação a objetos.


Benefícios


  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto.
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

title: Vibecoder
description:
A Human é um ecossistema criado por criativos para criativos, que nasceu para explorar o encontro entre criatividade humana e inteligência artificial.


Nascemos da prática e estamos criando projetos reais, testando novas ferramentas e desenvolvendo novos fluxos de trabalho todos os dias dentro de empresas como Google, Nestlé e Stone.


Acreditamos que a inteligência artificial não substitui a criatividade, mas expande as possibilidades de quem cria.

Por isso, construímos um ambiente onde pessoas curiosas, inquietas e mão na massa podem explorar, testar, errar, aprender rápido e evoluir junto com o mercado (e junto com a gente).


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Criar ferramentas, automações e integrações com IA que melhorem o dia a dia dos nossos times;
  • Desenvolver workflows inteligentes para projetos criativos e campanhas;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com times criativos, estratégicos e de produto;
  • Testar e implementar novas ferramentas (Lovable, Replit, Claude Code, GPT Codex, etc.);
  • Transformar IA em processo (não só em experimentação).


Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência construindo produtos (projetos próprios, freelas, startups ou dentro de empresas);
  • Familiaridade com vibe coding e ferramentas de AI-assisted coding;
  • Mentalidade prática: tirar ideias do papel rápido;
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com times criativos;
  • Interesse real por criatividade, cultura e tecnologia.


Vai ser um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência criando automações ou agentes de IA;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit, entre outras;
  • Já ter atuado em projetos criativos ou campanhas;
  • Interesse em explorar novas formas de criação com IA.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:

This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)

  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
SRE for NOC - 1st/2nd Line Support

**Supporting USA Time Zone - 7am to 5pm Pacific time**


Skills

  • SRE
  • Network Operations Centre experience
  • Incident Management - Troubleshoot and Raise Tickets
  • Linux Environment (Commands)
  • Python Scripting
  • Cloud - GCP/AWS


Overview

We are seeking an experienced NOC Support Analyst to join our 24/7 monitoring team. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive system monitoring , first‑line troubleshooting , and escalation to second‑ and third‑line teams when required. Each shift is staffed by two engineers, with one acting as the Manager on Duty (MOD) .


This position is ideal for someone with solid NOC experience who is also looking for career growth opportunities in Automation , SRE , and systems optimisation .

  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to refine processes and reduce manual intervention.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or similar operations environment.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring tools, incident workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, 24/7 environment with shared responsibility across shifts.


Ideal Candidate Profile

This role may be a great fit for:

  • A Junior Software Engineer with an interest in operational systems, automation, and reliability engineering.
  • Someone eager to grow into an SRE -focused position through hands-on exposure and mentorship.
  • A candidate passionate about operational excellence and continuously improving system reliability.

description:
Há 10 anos no mercado, a V8.Tech é uma empresa jovem, movida por tecnologia e inovação, que acelera a transformação digital. Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O profissional atuará na migração de códigos Java para .NET.
  • Desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs baseadas em arquitetura hexagonal, garantindo a exposição de dados para diferentes clientes por meio de REST APIs e tópicos corporativos.
  • Atuar na evolução e modernização de aplicações legadas escritas em VB6, VB.NET e ASP.NET, integrando-as com novas soluções baseadas em .NET e microserviços.
  • Construir adapters, barramentos e camadas anticorruption (ACL) para interligar sistemas legados a novos serviços de forma segura e desacoplada.
  • Assegurar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, aplicando padrões como Arquitetura Hexagonal, DDD e Clean Architecture.
  • Implementar comunicação assíncrona e orientada a eventos, utilizando RabbitMQ para garantir resiliência e desacoplamento entre serviços e sistemas de dados.
  • Criar e otimizar queries SQL e NoSQL, garantindo eficiência e performance em ambientes com alto volume de dados, otimizando o processamento de workloads transacionais e analíticos.
  • Atuar na automação de testes e nos pipelines de CI/CD, promovendo qualidade, rastreabilidade e entregas contínuas.
  • Monitorar performance e identificar gargalos, assegurando respostas rápidas e escalabilidade do sistema.
  • Apoiar a squad na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos, garantindo alinhamento com a arquitetura do projeto.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de dados e integração com o Data Lake, possibilitando ingestão eficiente para uso por times de Data Science, BI e aplicações analíticas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de DevSecOps para promover segurança e governança do ambiente, assegurando conformidade, rastreabilidade e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Implementar estratégias de caching e otimização de latência, garantindo respostas rápidas para consumidores finais e sistemas analíticos.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET Core e .NET Framework (C#).
  • Conhecimento prático em VB.NET ou VB6. (Diferencial).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Vivência com arquitetura hexagonal e padrões de mensageria.
  • Experiência com APIs REST e múltiplos modelos de entrega de dados, como mensageria e data marts.
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de infraestrutura utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade, tracing e logging distribuído.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle e PL/SQL).
  • Sybase (Diferencial)
  • Capacidade de atuar em sistemas com alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Experiência prévia em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e colaboração em squads multidisciplinares.


Requisitos desejáveis


  • Experiência com design de APIs escaláveis para diferentes consumidores.
  • Conhecimento avançado em DataOps e integração de pipelines de dados.
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes e infraestrutura distribuída.
  • Experiência com event sourcing e padrões de mensageria avançados.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de data lakes e otimização de consumo para analytics
  • Conhecimentos de Java e orientação a objetos.


Benefícios


  • Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho Remoto.
  • Horário de trabalho flexível: De acordo com área de atuação e política interna;
  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:

This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python + React) — AI StartupSenior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Productivity Platform (Remote)
description:
Position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI Platform)


About Us

We are a fast-growing AI startup transforming how professionals interact with complex information. We build enterprise-grade AI productivity platforms used by researchers, analysts, and engineers at large companies and rapidly scaling teams.

Our platform powers advanced AI workflows such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, document intelligence, and structured data search — with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability in production environments.


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help design, build, and scale both the backend systems and frontend experiences of our AI platform. You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

This role is ideal for engineers who think end-to-end: you care about clean API design and reliable backend architecture, but you're equally motivated by building polished, responsive interfaces that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive.


Responsibilities


Backend & Platform

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services in Python
  • Develop and evolve RESTful and WebSocket APIs supporting AI workflows and enterprise use cases
  • Build and maintain AI orchestration layers (RAG pipelines, agent systems, retrieval modules)
  • Integrate multiple data sources: vector databases, structured/tabular data, files, and web search
  • Own backend architecture decisions with a strong focus on performance, security, and reliability


Frontend & User Experience

  • Build and iterate on production React interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clean, usable UI patterns — from research dashboards to interactive data views
  • Implement real-time features such as streaming responses, live status indicators, and dynamic content updates
  • Ensure frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices


Cross-Cutting

  • Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end
  • Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and automated testing across the stack
  • Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
  • Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (FastAPI or similar)
  • Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases
  • Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or AI agent systems
  • Familiarity with vector databases and semantic search (e.g. OpenSearch)
  • Experience with real-time interfaces (WebSockets, streaming, SSE)
  • Background in enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with Vercel for frontend hosting and deployment
  • Knowledge of authentication systems (e.g. Clerk, Auth0)
  • Knowledge of security best practices and compliance (SOC 2 is a plus)
  • Experience working with high-scale or high-availability systems


What We Offer

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems used by enterprise customers
  • High-impact role with ownership across the full stack
  • Flexible remote work (Worldwide)
  • Direct collaboration with experienced engineers and founders
  • Fast-paced environment with real production challenges
  • Strong influence on technical and product decisions


Location Remote (Worldwide)

Hiring Model Contractor

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital sowie Angular Ventures. Mit Hauptsitzen in Deutschland und Chicago ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen massiv steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager , der die strategisch wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen von Levity mit globalen Logistikführern verantwortet und ausbaut (z. B. Gebrüder Weiss, LKW Walter). Du übernimmst Accounts nach dem Sales-Abschluss mit dem Ziel, daraus Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich zu entwickeln.

Dies ist keine rein administrative Bestandskundenrolle. Es ist eine kommerzielle Position mit hohem Impact, Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen und das Vorantreiben signifikanter Umsatzexpansion. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Du verantwortest ein fokussiertes Portfolio von 3 bis 5 hochwertigen Enterprise Accounts.
  • Revenue Expansion: Du treibst starkes Wachstum innerhalb bestehender Accounts voran, indem du neue Abteilungen, Regionen und Use Cases erschließt.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du analysierst komplexe Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives sowie operativen Champions über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften hinweg auf.
  • Commercial Strategy: Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und Renewals und entwickelst Kunden hin zu langfristigen, großvolumigen Commitments.
  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Delivery sicherzustellen.
  • Travel: Regelmäßige Reisen zu Kundenstandorten (z. B. Hamburg, Wien, Belgien oder USA), um persönliche Beziehungen vor Ort zu pflegen.


DEIN PROFIL

  • Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise Account Management oder Sales, insbesondere in der Betreuung multinationaler Accounts.
  • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld ist essenziell. Du bist hands-on, denkst unternehmerisch und besitzt eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität.
  • AI & Tech Fluency: Du bist kein Engineer, kannst aber mit technischen Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe über den Nutzwert von KI-Workflows sprechen.
  • Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind zwingende Voraussetzungen.
  • Industry Background: Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL ist ein großes Plus. Wir sind jedoch offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen (Telco, Manufacturing, etc.).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Equity.
  • Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.
  • Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Chance, unser Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Flexibility: Remote-Work von überall in Europa oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Berliner Büro.
  • Team: Ein internationales, talentiertes Team aus über 20 Mitgliedern weltweit.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail. If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

description:

About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

This role reports directly to the leadership team and will play a key part in shaping the future of the brand.


Key Responsibilities


Growth Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and own the overall growth strategy for Mimi Beds
  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention
  • Lead and coordinate marketing initiatives across paid media, content, lifecycle marketing, and partnerships
  • Provide direction and oversight to team members supporting marketing execution


Paid Media & Customer Acquisition

  • Define paid media strategy across Meta, Google, and emerging channels
  • Guide campaign strategy, audience testing, and creative experimentation
  • Monitor performance metrics and ensure profitable scaling of acquisition channels


Conversion Optimization & Ecommerce Performance

  • Lead initiatives to improve conversion rate, AOV, and overall ecommerce performance
  • Work closely with the team to test landing pages, product pages, bundles, and promotional structures

Lifecycle Marketing & Retention

  • Oversee email and SMS marketing strategy
  • Develop initiatives to increase customer lifetime value and repeat purchases
  • Optimize lifecycle flows including welcome series, abandoned cart, and post-purchase engagement


Influencer & Creative Strategy

  • Guide the strategy for influencer partnerships and user-generated content
  • Ensure a consistent pipeline of high-performing creative for paid and organic channels
  • Collaborate with creators and internal team members to test and scale winning content


Analytics & Growth Insights

  • Track and analyze key growth metrics including:
  • Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
  • Return on ad spend (ROAS)
  • Marketing efficiency ratio (MER)
  • Conversion rate
  • Average order value
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for leadership


Qualifications


  • 7+ years of experience in growth marketing or performance marketing
  • Experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands
  • Strong experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok)
  • Experience developing growth strategy and managing marketing initiatives
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working with Shopify or ecommerce platforms

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital sowie Angular Ventures. Mit Hauptsitzen in Deutschland und Chicago ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen massiv steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager , der die strategisch wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen von Levity mit globalen Logistikführern verantwortet und ausbaut (z. B. Gebrüder Weiss, LKW Walter). Du übernimmst Accounts nach dem Sales-Abschluss mit dem Ziel, daraus Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich zu entwickeln.

Dies ist keine rein administrative Bestandskundenrolle. Es ist eine kommerzielle Position mit hohem Impact, Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen und das Vorantreiben signifikanter Umsatzexpansion. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Du verantwortest ein fokussiertes Portfolio von 3 bis 5 hochwertigen Enterprise Accounts.
  • Revenue Expansion: Du treibst starkes Wachstum innerhalb bestehender Accounts voran, indem du neue Abteilungen, Regionen und Use Cases erschließt.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du analysierst komplexe Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives sowie operativen Champions über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften hinweg auf.
  • Commercial Strategy: Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und Renewals und entwickelst Kunden hin zu langfristigen, großvolumigen Commitments.
  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Delivery sicherzustellen.
  • Travel: Regelmäßige Reisen zu Kundenstandorten (z. B. Hamburg, Wien, Belgien oder USA), um persönliche Beziehungen vor Ort zu pflegen.


DEIN PROFIL

  • Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise Account Management oder Sales, insbesondere in der Betreuung multinationaler Accounts.
  • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld ist essenziell. Du bist hands-on, denkst unternehmerisch und besitzt eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität.
  • AI & Tech Fluency: Du bist kein Engineer, kannst aber mit technischen Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe über den Nutzwert von KI-Workflows sprechen.
  • Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind zwingende Voraussetzungen.
  • Industry Background: Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL ist ein großes Plus. Wir sind jedoch offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen (Telco, Manufacturing, etc.).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Equity.
  • Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.
  • Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Chance, unser Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Flexibility: Remote-Work von überall in Europa oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Berliner Büro.
  • Team: Ein internationales, talentiertes Team aus über 20 Mitgliedern weltweit.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail. If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

Como Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.
