title: Corporate Attorney (US-Licensed, LATAM-Based)
description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking a US-licensed Corporate Attorney based in LATAM to take ownership of ongoing corporate legal work across a portfolio of startup clients.

This is a high-trust, senior role for someone who operates independently, understands business context, and can act as a true partner to founders and operators. You’ll manage day-to-day corporate matters across ~200 clients, working closely with leadership and integrating deeply into the team.

This is not a temporary or advisory-only position. We’re looking for someone who wants to embed long-term, take ownership, and grow with the firm .

What you’ll do

Corporate Legal Execution

  • Handle ongoing corporate matters across a portfolio of startup clients
  • Draft, review, and manage contracts and transactional documents
  • Support company formations, fund structures, and corporate governance
  • Prepare and review board resolutions, operating agreements, and related documents

Startup & Venture Support

  • Advise on venture financings (seed through growth stages)
  • Support founders through entity structuring, cap table decisions, and governance
  • Work closely with tools like Carta and similar platforms

Client Management

  • Manage relationships with 3–4 clients per day on average
  • Act as ongoing outside counsel embedded within client operations
  • Provide clear, pragmatic legal guidance aligned with business goals

Internal Collaboration

  • Work directly with the CEO, CFO, and core team
  • Participate in regular team syncs and collaborate cross-functionally
  • Help build a more efficient in-house legal capability as the firm scales

What we are looking for

Core Requirements

  • Active US Bar license (required)
  • Based in LATAM (Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia preferred)
  • Strong experience in corporate law for startups
  • Background supporting venture financings, fund formation, and governance
  • Experience working with US-based clients or companies
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Domain of Carta software tool

Who you are

  • Senior, independent operator who does not require hand-holding
  • Comfortable owning workstreams end-to-end across multiple clients
  • Strong business judgment, not just legal theory
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, but highly self-directed
  • Intuitive, proactive, and able to understand context quickly
  • Interested in long-term growth, not short-term engagements


Why join

  • High ownership: Be the core corporate legal partner across a large client base
  • Startup exposure: Work across a wide range of venture-backed companies
  • Flexibility: Fully remote, high-autonomy environment
  • Growth: Opportunity to become a foundational part of the firm’s long-term structure

Interview Process

  • Initial conversation with CEO
  • Follow-up conversation with 1–2 attorneys
  • Final decision

Role Structure & Compensation

  • Location: Remote (LATAM-based)
  • Type: Contract-to-full-time (open to both)
  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience
  • Benefits: PTO & holidays, full benefits for full-time role.


If interested, also please email us with your resume and cover letter at

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 7 anos de experiência com Java e Spring Boot para desenvolvimento backend;

- Vivência em cloud Amazon Web Services com serviços como EKS, S3, Lambda e API Gateway;

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior Security Analyst OR Senior Information Security Analyst (GRC)
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Support security governance, risk assessments, and audit activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)
  • Monitor security metrics and identify compliance gaps or risks
  • Track and drive remediation of security issues with application and platform teams
  • Ensure security controls are effectively designed and implemented
  • Prepare reports and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance security processes and controls

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience in information security, IT risk, compliance, or audit roles
  • Strong understanding of frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or similar
  • Experience supporting audits, assurance activities, and remediation efforts
  • Familiarity with security metrics, control monitoring, and SLA-based compliance
  • Experience working with system or application owners to resolve security issues
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills for risk and compliance tracking
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Knowledge of cloud, SaaS, or enterprise platforms
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as Panaseer, Checkmarx, or Wiz

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CISSP (or in progress)
  • Experience in regulated or data-driven environments
  • Familiarity with privacy, data protection, or third-party risk management

title: Senior Back-end Architect (Python)
description:
I’m helping Staffinit find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Senior Back-end Architect (Python) .


You'll architect high-performance AI evaluation systems, directly impacting customer experience at scale.


Compensation:

USD 46.2 - 59.8/hour.


Location:

Remote (specific timezones).


Mission of Staffinit:

\"Our mission: to connect talent. empower businesses. We work with clients across industries, helping them build teams that make a difference, and support professionals in finding roles where they can thrive. At our core, we combine deep recruitment expertise with a human-centred approach—ensuring that each placement aligns skills, culture and ambition.

\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You are proficient in REST API, Query optimization, Event-driven architecture (EDA), Data modeling.
  • You have +3 years experience in Python, Asynchronous programming.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) at the Architect / Team Leader / Principal Engineer level to collaborate with our Customer.


Project:

- The project is being carried out for a German client and involves building an evaluation platform — a key system enabling the testing of AI agents through simulated scenarios and monitoring of performance results.


Role in the Project:

- The Senior Python Backend Engineer will collaborate with an internal development team and technical leads.

- The role includes full ownership of building and developing solutions and deploying them to production environments.

- Microservices must be high-performance, low-latency, scalable, and reliable.


Candidate Expectations:

- A combination of deep Python knowledge with system design skills, architectural thinking, independence, and proactivity.

- Strong sense of ownership.

- Strong communication skills.

- Independence in designing and evolving system architecture.

- These solutions directly impact the quality of experience for customers testing and deploying AI agents at scale.


Collaboration Model:

- Contract through end of 2026 with a high likelihood of extension.

- Remote work (100% FTE).

- Project team of 4–5 people based in Poland.

- Occasional visits to the Berlin office possible.


Team Office Meetings:

- The client organizes so-called in-office weeks — typically 3–5 days in the office, approximately twice per quarter.

- We try to schedule these flexibly around the team.

- Part of the team works from the UK and also joins these meetings.

- Attendance is not mandatory but is appreciated for collaboration and team building.


Requirements:

Python and Backend:

- Strong knowledge of modern Python, at least 3 years of experience with versions 3.10 and above (asyncio, concurrency, asynchronous programming).

- Experience building backend services running in production environments, 7+ years expected.


System Design and Maintenance:

- Designing and implementing REST APIs.

- Designing scalable distributed systems.

- Experience with event-driven architecture or task queue-based systems.

- Designing fault-tolerant and overload-resistant systems.

- Experience maintaining production systems.


Data Processing and Persistence:

- Production experience with databases (NoSQL, MongoDB preferred).

- Data modeling, schema management, migrations.

- Query and database structure optimization.


Concurrency and Task Processing:

- Background task processing architecture.

- Handling long-running and parallel tasks.

- Worker models and process isolation.


Engineering Ownership and Communication:

- End-to-end ownership of delivered solutions — from analyzing and verifying requirements, designing architecture, through to production deployment.

- Ability to make technical decisions, analyze and address risks.

- Good English communication skills.


Nice to Have:

Python Ecosystem:

- FastAPI or other async web frameworks.

- Pydantic and type-based validation.

- Static type checking (mypy).


Distributed and Event-Driven Systems:

- Kafka or similar streaming systems.

- Task queuing and load distribution systems.

- Multi-tenant system design.


Cloud and Containerization:

- Kubernetes and container deployments.

- CI/CD and deployment automation.


System Observability:

- Distributed tracing systems (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

- Metrics-based monitoring and SLOs.


Performance and Scaling:

- High-throughput systems.

- Load balancing and queue sharding.


AI / LLM Integrations:

- Integration with language model APIs.

- Designing evaluation and scoring pipelines.

- Managing rate limits and model query costs.


Work Environment and Tooling:

Backend and Infrastructure:

- FastAPI, Uvicorn,

- MongoDB (Motor).

- Redis (task queues).

- Kafka / Azure Event Hubs.

- Kong as middleware layer for LLM integrations.


Observability and Monitoring:

- OpenTelemetry.

- Datadog.

- Structured logging and trace correlation.


Delivery and Infrastructure:

- Kubernetes and Helm.

- Docker (multi-stage builds).

- GitHub Actions (CI/CD).

- ArgoCD (GitOps).


Python Tooling:

- UV (dependency management).

- Ruff, mypy.

- Pytest, testcontainers.


AI Integrations:

- OpenAI SDK and structured model responses.

- LLM Gateway architecture.

- Token usage and rate limit control.

title: Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems
description:
Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems

Contract - 12 Months

LATM Based - Remote Work


The Partner Analyst supports the development, governance, and optimisation of global partner programs across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud . The role ensures partner program compliance, manages certifications and audits, maintains partner tier requirements, and oversees accurate pipeline reporting and deal registration across multiple partner portals. You’ll work cross‑functionally with sales, marketing, delivery, and finance to help maintain top‑tier partner status and maximise incentives, funding, and joint business opportunities.


Key Responsibilities

Partner Program Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain partner tiers, competencies, certifications, and renewals across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP.
  • Manage audits, compliance requirements, user access, and certification tracking across partner portals (SAP for Me, ACE, MPC, PNH).
  • Support insurance, legal, and other compliance obligations.

SAP Program Support

  • Support PE Build, Sell, and Service track requirements and SAP Gold‑level compliance.
  • Manage global pipeline reporting, V2V/TI requirements, SAP‑sourced deal tracking, RISE Validated activities, CC Flex registrations, and development funding requests.

AWS Program Support

  • Support competencies (SAP Consulting, Migration & Modernization) and Premier Tier/Reseller/MSP requirements.
  • Manage ACE deal registration, reporting, funding submissions, and user/certification tracking.

Microsoft Program Support

  • Support ISD and SAP on Azure specialization.
  • Manage MPC deal registration, certification tracking, and funding submissions.

Google Cloud Program Support

  • Maintain Select Tier status, competencies, audits, deal registration, and funding submissions in PNH.

Analytics & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Track partner performance metrics and compliance status.
  • Produce dashboards, reports, and insights for leadership and partner QBRs.
  • Support GTM plans and partner‑aligned offerings.

Relationship & Coordination Support

  • Assist Sales Leaders with partner relationship management.
  • Coordinate onboarding, documentation, internal enablement, and representing in partner reviews and audits.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Technology (MBA preferred).
  • 3+ years’ experience in partner management, alliances, or cloud program operations.
  • Knowledge of SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and reporting skills.
  • Experience with partner portals and certification management.
  • SAP and cloud partner program experience strongly preferred.
  • Background check required in line with applicable law.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems
description:
Partner Analyst – Global Cloud & SAP Ecosystems

Contract - 12 Months

LATM Based - Remote Work


The Partner Analyst supports the development, governance, and optimisation of global partner programs across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud . The role ensures partner program compliance, manages certifications and audits, maintains partner tier requirements, and oversees accurate pipeline reporting and deal registration across multiple partner portals. You’ll work cross‑functionally with sales, marketing, delivery, and finance to help maintain top‑tier partner status and maximise incentives, funding, and joint business opportunities.


Key Responsibilities

Partner Program Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain partner tiers, competencies, certifications, and renewals across SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP.
  • Manage audits, compliance requirements, user access, and certification tracking across partner portals (SAP for Me, ACE, MPC, PNH).
  • Support insurance, legal, and other compliance obligations.

SAP Program Support

  • Support PE Build, Sell, and Service track requirements and SAP Gold‑level compliance.
  • Manage global pipeline reporting, V2V/TI requirements, SAP‑sourced deal tracking, RISE Validated activities, CC Flex registrations, and development funding requests.

AWS Program Support

  • Support competencies (SAP Consulting, Migration & Modernization) and Premier Tier/Reseller/MSP requirements.
  • Manage ACE deal registration, reporting, funding submissions, and user/certification tracking.

Microsoft Program Support

  • Support ISD and SAP on Azure specialization.
  • Manage MPC deal registration, certification tracking, and funding submissions.

Google Cloud Program Support

  • Maintain Select Tier status, competencies, audits, deal registration, and funding submissions in PNH.

Analytics & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Track partner performance metrics and compliance status.
  • Produce dashboards, reports, and insights for leadership and partner QBRs.
  • Support GTM plans and partner‑aligned offerings.

Relationship & Coordination Support

  • Assist Sales Leaders with partner relationship management.
  • Coordinate onboarding, documentation, internal enablement, and representing in partner reviews and audits.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or Technology (MBA preferred).
  • 3+ years’ experience in partner management, alliances, or cloud program operations.
  • Knowledge of SAP, AWS, Microsoft, and GCP ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and reporting skills.
  • Experience with partner portals and certification management.
  • SAP and cloud partner program experience strongly preferred.
  • Background check required in line with applicable law.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

description:

Contratação: PJ

Período de alocação: 1 mês

Local: Remoto


Descrição da Posição:

Atuar como Arquiteto(a) de Segurança especializado(a) em CyberArk Secrets Manager, sendo responsável pelo desenho, definição e sustentação da arquitetura de gerenciamento de segredos, apoiando iniciativas de remoção de credenciais hardcoded, integração com aplicações e fortalecimento da esteira DevSecOps.

O profissional será o referencial técnico para decisões arquiteturais relacionadas a secrets management, garantindo aderência a boas práticas de segurança, requisitos de compliance e padrões corporativos do cliente.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir e manter a arquitetura de CyberArk Secrets Manager (Conjur) para ambientes on-premises, cloud ou híbridos.
  • Atuar no desenho de soluções para remoção de credenciais em código, substituindo por consumo seguro via Secrets Manager.
  • Apoiar a integração de aplicações (ex.: .NET, Java, microsserviços) com CyberArk, incluindo pipelines CI/CD.
  • Definir padrões técnicos, modelos de integração e boas práticas para consumo de segredos por aplicações.

  • Avaliar riscos técnicos e apoiar na definição de controles de segurança, autenticação, autorização e segregação de ambientes.
  • Apoiar processos de auditoria e conformidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e governança no uso de credenciais.
  • Revisar entregas técnicas, validar arquitetura e apoiar troubleshooting de integrações complexas.
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente e, quando necessário, junto ao fabricante.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com CyberArk Secrets Manager / CyberArk Conjur.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de segurança de aplicações e gerenciamento de segredos.
  • Experiência com DevSecOps, integração em pipelines CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Conhecimento em integração de aplicações (ex.: Java, .NET, APIs, microsserviços).
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de IAM, PAM, autenticação, autorização e criptografia.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de código para apoiar integrações.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, com foco em segurança, compliance e auditoria.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Vivência em projetos de modernização de aplicações ou migração para DevSecOps.
  • Conhecimento de containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certificações em CyberArk ou Segurança da Informação (desejável).

title: Arquiteto(a) de Segurança – CyberArk Secrets
description:
Arquiteto(a) de Segurança – CyberArk Secrets


Contratação: PJ

Período de alocação: 1 mês

Local: Remoto


Descrição da Posição:

Atuar como Arquiteto(a) de Segurança especializado(a) em CyberArk Secrets Manager, sendo responsável pelo desenho, definição e sustentação da arquitetura de gerenciamento de segredos, apoiando iniciativas de remoção de credenciais hardcoded, integração com aplicações e fortalecimento da esteira DevSecOps.

O profissional será o referencial técnico para decisões arquiteturais relacionadas a secrets management, garantindo aderência a boas práticas de segurança, requisitos de compliance e padrões corporativos do cliente.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir e manter a arquitetura de CyberArk Secrets Manager (Conjur) para ambientes on-premises, cloud ou híbridos.
  • Atuar no desenho de soluções para remoção de credenciais em código, substituindo por consumo seguro via Secrets Manager.
  • Apoiar a integração de aplicações (ex.: .NET, Java, microsserviços) com CyberArk, incluindo pipelines CI/CD.
  • Definir padrões técnicos, modelos de integração e boas práticas para consumo de segredos por aplicações.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, DevOps e segurança para viabilizar a adoção da solução.
  • Avaliar riscos técnicos e apoiar na definição de controles de segurança, autenticação, autorização e segregação de ambientes.
  • Apoiar processos de auditoria e conformidade, garantindo rastreabilidade e governança no uso de credenciais.
  • Revisar entregas técnicas, validar arquitetura e apoiar troubleshooting de integrações complexas.
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente e, quando necessário, junto ao fabricante.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com CyberArk Secrets Manager / CyberArk Conjur.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de segurança de aplicações e gerenciamento de segredos.
  • Experiência com DevSecOps, integração em pipelines CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Conhecimento em integração de aplicações (ex.: Java, .NET, APIs, microsserviços).
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de IAM, PAM, autenticação, autorização e criptografia.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de código para apoiar integrações.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, com foco em segurança, compliance e auditoria.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Vivência em projetos de modernização de aplicações ou migração para DevSecOps.
  • Conhecimento de containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certificações em CyberArk ou Segurança da Informação (desejável).

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
International Marketing Specialist | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Marketing Assistant to support digital marketing operations for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Digital Marketing and Marketing Operations.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000
  • 100% remote, aligned with PST working hours
  • Direct exposure to international clients and global teams
  • Long-term position
  • Participation in strategic digital marketing projects
  • Structured, dynamic, and performance-driven environment
  • Real growth opportunities into higher-responsibility roles


Your Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of digital marketing campaigns
  • Assist in organizing scopes, timelines, and KPIs
  • Update and manage project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Jira, Trello)
  • Coordinate communication between designers, copywriters, media buyers, and developers
  • Ensure organization of briefings, assets, and documentation
  • Track creative deliverables and deadlines
  • Collect and organize campaign performance metrics (paid media, social, email, SEO)
  • Support KPI analysis and performance reporting
  • Identify potential operational risks and escalate when necessary
  • Participate in internal meetings and, when needed, client calls
  • Prepare summaries and follow-ups to ensure team alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in digital marketing or agency environment
  • Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Familiarity with project management tools
  • Functional knowledge of digital channels (social, paid media, email, SEO, landing pages)
  • Advanced or fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, remote environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in agencies or startups
  • Experience working with international clients
  • Knowledge of dashboards and performance reporting
  • Certifications in digital marketing or project management


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with good performance
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office


Build your international career in Marketing.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

description:

Se você é alguém que gosta de conectar estratégia com execução, transformar complexidade em clareza e ver produto indo pra produção com qualidade e velocidade, essa vaga é pra você

Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um Consultor SAP BRIM Sênior com forte experiência em SAP Convergent Charging (CC) para atuação em projetos e sustentação de soluções de billing e charging em ambientes de alta volumetria. O profissional será responsável pela modelagem, configuração e operação de cenários complexos de tarifação em tempo real e batch, integrando os componentes do SAP BRIM, como SOM, CI, FI-CA, e sistemas externos, como mediation, billing e CRM.


A posição envolve participação em implementações end-to-end, melhorias evolutivas e AMS, com forte atuação em desenho de solução, troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e suporte à arquitetura BRIM.

• Conhecimento sólido de SAP BRIM (arquitetura end-to-end);

• Conhecimento de billing para telecom ou utilities.

• Experiência com análise de dados de alta volumetria e performance tuning.

Diferenciais


• Experiência com SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management);

• Conhecimento em SAP CI e FI-CA.

• Experiência com cenários pré-pagos e pós-pagos.

• Experiência em ambientes de grande escala (telecom ou utilities).


Competências Comportamentais


• Perfil analítico e orientado à solução.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

• Proatividade e autonomia;

Profissional sênior, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente em ambientes BRIM complexos, contribuindo com desenho de solução, sustentação de ambientes de alta volumetria e atuando como referência técnica em SAP Convergent Charging dentro do projeto ou operação.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei analista de testes, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Habilidades avançadas em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada com UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator, Robots).
  • Sólida experiência no desenvolvimento e na manutenção de soluções de RPA em ambientes de produção.
  • Experiência com depuração e otimização de fluxos de automação.
  • Sólido entendimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) e das melhores práticas.
  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade analítica.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com stakeholders de negócio.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Projetos para atuar em iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia e transformação digital, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução das nossas soluções, processos e produtos. Esse profissional terá a missão de liderar iniciativas multidisciplinares, facilitar a colaboração entre áreas e garantir entregas que impulsionem inovação, eficiência e resultados tangíveis. Procuramos alguém com visão analítica, forte capacidade de organização, domínio de práticas ágeis e experiência sólida na condução de projetos de grande porte em ambientes corporativos.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gerenciar, organizar e direcionar iniciativas relacionadas a tecnologia e transformação digital;
  • Atuar em colaboração com times multidisciplinares — negócio, produto, tecnologia e dados — para garantir a entrega de soluções digitais de alto impacto;
  • Participar da definição, planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, produtos e iniciativas tecnológicas;
  • Apoiar a priorização de demandas, a definição de backlog e o planejamento de entregas;
  • Facilitar cerimônias e práticas ágeis, contribuindo para a organização e eficiência do trabalho da equipe;
  • Colaborar na definição de soluções, arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, quando necessário;
  • Garantir comunicação clara e alinhamento entre stakeholders técnicos e áreas de negócio;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, progresso das entregas e evolução das iniciativas sob sua coordenação;
  • Identificar riscos, dependências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e nas soluções;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua das práticas de gestão, produto, arquitetura e agilidade dentro das equipes.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos, gestão de produtos, agilidade ou arquitetura de soluções;
  • Vivência em ambientes de tecnologia e transformação digital;
  • Experiência de trabalho com times multidisciplinares de negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis como Scrum, Kanban ou frameworks similares;
  • Experiência com planejamento, priorização e acompanhamento de iniciativas tecnológicas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação eficaz com stakeholders de diferentes níveis e áreas;
  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo, organizado e orientado a resultados;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos ou projetos de grande porte;
  • Vivência em papéis como Scrum Master, Product Owner, Gerente de Projetos ou Arquiteto de Soluções;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas, cloud computing e integrações;
  • Certificações como PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, TOGAF ou equivalentes serão consideradas um diferencial;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais, plataformas ou programas de transformação digital;
  • Atuação prévia em estruturas ágeis ou squads de produto.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ).
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde.
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Tech Lead Java

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você atuará como principal referência técnica de TI para o time e para o cliente, sendo responsável por garantir a qualidade das entregas, a evolução técnica da equipe e um ambiente colaborativo alinhado à cultura. Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
  • Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
  • Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
  • Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
  • Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;
  • Resolver conflitos e manter um ambiente colaborativo, positivo e focado em resultados.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java , com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);
  • Domínio de Spring Boot , incluindo construção de APIs, segurança, persistência de dados e organização de aplicações escaláveis e de fácil manutenção;
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, com capacidade de modelagem, escrita de queries eficientes e entendimento de performance e uso adequado de cada tecnologia;
  • Vivência com AWS , compreendendo o uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda no contexto de aplicações reais, incluindo deploy, configuração e monitoramento básico;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful , seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão utilizando Git, incluindo colaboração em equipe, code review e organização de branches;
  • Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
  • Capacidade analítica, autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Tiver vivência com desenvolvimento de arquiteturas resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Tiver conhecimento em ferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior QA Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Senior QA Data Engineer , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

Lead QA initiatives for one or more projects, including planning, execution, and reporting.

Develop, maintain, and execute automated and manual test scripts, leveraging tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing frameworks.

Mentor and guide junior QA team members, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

Analyze testing results, identify issues, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.

Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies, providing insights on testing progress and quality metrics. Identify scenarios suitable for automation, optimize testing strategies, and improve testing efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and Stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.

Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring quick resolution and continuous improvement. Stay updated on industry best practices, testing tools, and methodologies.


Technical Skills & Knowledge:

Testing Strategies: Expertise in functional, integration, unit, regression, and exploratory testing. Automation & Scripting: Proficient in Java and Python; experience with Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing. Frameworks & Tools: Experience in creating custom test frameworks; familiarity with GitHub Copilot for automation.

Methodologies: Agile/Scrum experience, ISTQB CTFL certification is a plus.

Testing Approaches: Knowledge of BDD, web testing, and performance testing. Version Control & Management: Proficient in JIRA and GitHub. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Strong problem-solving abilities with a creative and efficient mindset. Ability to work independently, self-manage, and adapt quickly to changing priorities. Team-oriented, collaborative, and proactive in seeking solutions and improvements. Organized and capable of planning testing activities effectively. Deep understanding of the product’s purpose and how testing contributes to overall quality. Qualifications: 3-5 years of experience in software QA or related fields. Advanced knowledge of testing tools and automation frameworks. ISTQB CTFL certification (preferred). Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and best practices


Mandatory Skills:

  • SQL
  • Python programming
  • Robot Framework -
  • Automate testing
  • BDD


Data Pipelines: Experience validating and testing ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

Databases: Strong understanding of SQL and experience working with relational and/or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar).

Data Processing: Familiarity with data transformation tools and frameworks (e.g., Python-based processing, Spark concepts, or equivalent).

Data Quality: Ability to define and implement data quality checks, reconciliation rules, and monitoring for anomalies.

APIs & Integration: Experience testing data integrations, APIs, and downstream consumers (dashboards, reports, or analytics use cases).

Cloud & DevOps (Nice to Have): Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines supporting data and test automation workflows.
