title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)
description:
AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)

We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for

  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Senior WordPress Developer (Enterprise CMS / CUE)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to migration projects from enterprise CMS platforms to WordPress , especially newsroom/editorial systems.
  • Design and implement content migration pipelines , including data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL).
  • Work with editorial teams to map content models, taxonomies, and workflows into WordPress.
  • Develop custom plugins and scripts to support large-scale content migrations .
  • Integrate WordPress with APIs from legacy or external CMS platforms.
  • Ensure data integrity, SEO preservation, and minimal downtime during migrations.
  • Optimize WordPress architecture for scalability in content-heavy environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with strong backend focus.
  • Experience with Stibo DX CUE (CUE Platform) .
  • Proven experience in CMS migration projects (any enterprise CMS → WordPress) .
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST APIs.
  • Experience handling large-scale content datasets .
  • Understanding of content modeling, taxonomies, and editorial workflows.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with other enterprise CMS platforms
  • Familiarity with media/publishing environments.
  • Experience with headless CMS architectures.
  • Knowledge of SEO considerations during migrations (URL structures, redirects, metadata preservation).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • O profissional deve ter forte base em estatística aplicada a problemas do mundo real, domínio de Python e SQL, e experiência em feature engineering, validação e interpretação de modelos.
  • É desejável vivência com cloud, preferencialmente Azure, além de familiaridade com engenharia de dados, bancos e arquitetura de dados e visualização de dados.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Sr Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Analyst
description:
Sr Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Analyst


Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 Months w/possible extension

City: Remote

Candidates must be located in Brazil, (Sao Paolo preferred)

Client Industry: Agriculture



Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Systems, Risk Management, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 7+ years of experience in third-party risk management, cybersecurity risk, or GRC.
  • Proven experience building or significantly enhancing a TPRM program.
  • Strong experience reviewing SOC 2 reports and vendor security questionnaires.
  • Experience conducting vendor cybersecurity assessments.
  • Hands-on experience with a GRC platform (e.g., RSA Archer, LogicManager, ServiceNow GRC, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of vendor risk frameworks and control environments.
  • Experience writing clear, executive-level risk reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, build-mode environments.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and drive initiatives to completion.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and mature the enterprise data governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.
  • Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, and accountability structures.
  • Stand up and manage governance forums, working groups, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data domain model.
  • Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.
  • Embed governance and classification controls into system development and intake processes.
  • Maintain the enterprise data classification framework and associated handling and protection requirements.
  • Map regulatory and contractual obligations to data classes and ensure appropriate controls are enforced.
  • Define secure data storage requirements and validate compliance with encryption, access, and monitoring standards.
  • Monitor storage environments to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
  • Govern role‑based access, periodic reviews, and monitoring of data usage and behavior.
  • Partner with cross functional teams to detect and respond to inappropriate access.
  • Establish secure data sharing and transmission standards and govern internal/external disclosures.
  • Maintain approval workflows, logging, and traceability for data transfers.
  • Assess data sharing risks in partnership with Third‑Party Risk Management.
  • Develop and maintain data retention schedules aligned with legal, regulatory, and business needs.
  • Govern archival processes and access restrictions for inactive data.
  • Define secure data destruction standards, validate retention obligations, and maintain destruction evidence.
  • Oversee third‑party destruction activities for compliance.
  • Develop KPIs, KRIs, maturity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Identify program gaps, drive remediation, and support audits and regulatory examinations.
  • Serve as the enterprise SME for data governance, providing training and awareness.
  • Build relationships with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and business units to promote adoption.
  • Support AI governance and trusted‑data initiatives.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ).
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde.
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Ingeniero de integración
description:
Job Description: The AI Division in the IT Department needs a Senior Integrations Engineer. The incumbent will mainly focus on the design, implementation and testing of integration solutions supporting the Fund's on-prem and cloud platforms. This position will specifically contribute to the implementation of schedule-based integration components and complementary resources for an important project. In addition, this role will investigate current industry trends from the integrations platform perspective and recommend solutions to any integration challenges using new/latest technologies.


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline; advanced degree in above disciplines preferred.
  • 5-8 years of experience with direct responsibility in software development and/or integrations implementation is required.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in building batch and scheduled processes using Azure Data Factory with its complementary services like DataFlows, Notifications, Integration Runtimes, etc.
  • Experienced in implementing and maintaining data transformations processes/rules as part of the implementation of ADF pipelines.
  • Proficient using APIs, scheduled-based, message-based, and event-based platforms such as Azure Integration Services (API Management/Gateway, Service Bus, Data Factory, Functions, Logic Apps) as well as modern authentication/authorization mechanisms in the context of building/maintaining ADF pipelines and processes.
  • Working knowledge of parsing/transforming data coming from SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) and REST (Representational State Transfer) services in the context of implementing ADF pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of leveraging cloud-native and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Strong programming and scripting languages (C#, Java, Python, NodeJS, PowerShell)
  • Knowledge of writing complex and efficient SQL queries for relational and no-SQL databases such as MS SQL Server, CosmosDB, MongoDB, and others. Proficiency building integrations with MS 365 and other CMS is a plus.
  • Familiarity with code versioning and issue tracking tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • Substantial experience working with DevSecOps tooling; including code auditing and analysis, implementation of CI/CD pipelines, automated release and deployment, infrastructure as code (IaC), and automated security scans.
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to quickly build credibility and trust with internal colleagues.
  • Great ability to work in a fast-moving environment and with minimal supervision. Also, collaborates across boundaries, gives own perspective and willingly receives diverse perspectives.
  • Excellent documentation (writing and diagramming), interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Ability to pay attention to detail and solve problems and issues efficiently and skilled in developing integration systems in a Scrum/Agile SDLC Environment.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

AI Digital is a leading end-to-end programmatic agency empowering brands and agencies with transparent, unbiased, AI-enhanced media solutions. title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,800 - $3,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are looking for a Technical Consultant  with a strong mix of technical expertise and problem-solving skills to drive the successful deployment and personalization of our partner's software for their clients. This is a customer-facing, hands-on role  that requires a strong blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, excellent soft skills, and a customer-first mindset.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical capability (particularly with JavaScript and SQL ) to translate defined business requirements into practical software configurations. You must be deeply curious about solving unique technical challenges and skilled at working within our highly configurable platform. This role involves direct system configuration and may include acting as an extension of the client's internal team under our partner's management, demanding excellent communication and adaptability. While not a full-stack development position, it requires more technical capability than a business analyst, with a focus on applying coding and configuration skills to deliver functional solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Leverage SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and Excel to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize system functionality.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their specific requirements before writing any code to ensure solutions fully align with business needs.
  • Identify root causes of technical issues before proposing and implementing solutions.
  • Monitor system performance and availability, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Document support activities, issue resolutions, and configuration changes for internal records and customer transparency.
  • Collaborate with consultants, internal teams, and customers to create optimized and scalable solutions.
  • Learn about the company’s highly configurable software system, developing expertise in its unique problem-solving methods.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, Solution Consultant, or similar roles.
  • Technical proficiency in SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and Excel.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset and the ability to diagnose root causes before acting.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. 
  • Customer-first approach in finding the best solution for the client.
  • Curiosity and creativity with the ability to think outside the box when tackling complex system configurations. 
  • Learning-first mentality.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in configuration or system analysis for business applications.
  • Experience with business analysis or enterprise software implementation.
  • Background in engineering.
  • Ability to work independently and seek out creative solutions in a constantly evolving environment.


Work Schedule:  EST or later to overlap with European teams


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:
A Culture Designer, consultoria em gestão de pessoas, está apoiando uma consultoria contábil estratégica na contratação de um profissional para atuar na área contábil com foco consultivo e relacionamento com clientes!


Conheça um pouco sobre a empresa contratante

Com mais de 20 anos de atuação sólida no mercado brasileiro, a empresa é especializada em impulsionar o crescimento de empresas de base tecnológica, startups e agências de inovação. Seu diferencial está em transformar a contabilidade tradicional em uma ferramenta estratégica de inteligência de negócios. Com uma cultura dinâmica e orientada ao suporte consultivo, a organização atua de forma próxima aos clientes, utilizando tecnologia de ponta e um atendimento altamente personalizado para apoiar gestores na tomada de decisões mais assertivas.


Principais Atividades:

  • Responsável pela execução da rotina contábil completa, incluindo lançamentos, conciliações bancárias, apuração de impostos e fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Elaboração de demonstrativos e relatórios contábeis gerenciais, como balancetes, com apresentação de informações para a controladoria.

  • Participação ativa em reuniões com clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas, apresentando análises e propondo melhorias.
  • Garantia de compliance contábil, assegurando o cumprimento das normas e legislações vigentes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com rotina contábil completa.
  • Vivência com elaboração de balancetes e relatórios contábeis.
  • Conhecimento na ferramenta Domínio.
  • Domínio de Excel.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento na ferramenta Conta Azul.


Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Organização e boa gestão do tempo.
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas.
  • Raciocínio lógico e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para elaboração de pareceres técnicos.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com clientes.


Remuneração & Benefícios:

title: Assistente Administrativo (Foco em Controladoria de Mídia)
description:
Objetivo do Cargo

Atuar como braço direito da Controladoria de Mídia, sendo responsável pela execução operacional, conferência de documentos e suporte ao faturamento das contas estratégicas. O foco será garantir o compliance entre o planejado pela mídia e o executado pelo financeiro.


Principais Responsabilidades (Demandas Específicas)

  • Gestão de PIs e POs: Responsável direto pela organização, lançamento e acompanhamento do fluxo de PIs e POs, assegurando que todos os processos ocorram mediante aprovação sistêmica.
  • Conferência de Fechamento: Realizar o controle de verbas de plataformas identificando divergências para correção imediata.
  • Suporte aos Kits de Fechamento: Organizar e validar toda a documentação necessária para os fechamentos mensais (Notas Fiscais, comprovantes e PIs).
  • Interface Mídia x Financeiro: Atuar como ponto de contato para coletar informações dos times de mídia, garantindo que os prazos de faturamento sejam cumpridos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Graduação (concluída ou cursando) em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Vivência anterior em rotinas administrativas ou financeiras (experiência em agência de publicidade será um diferencial).
  • Excel/Google Sheets: Nível intermediário (domínio de fórmulas para cruzamento de dados e tabelas dinâmicas).
  • Habilidades Pessoais: Senso de urgência, extrema atenção a detalhes, organização e boa comunicação interpessoal


O que oferecemos:

  • Auxílio Transporte.
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Vale Refeição
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Ambiente de aprendizado acelerado (você vai colocar a mão na massa de verdade).
  • Cultura colaborativa e foco em resultados.


Onde e Quando?

  • Modelo: Atuação remota
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta(09:00 ás 18:00 ou 10:00 ás 19:00)

title: AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)
description:
AI Web Engineer (Systems & Automation)

We’re looking for an AI web engineer who can both ship high-quality websites using tools like Claude Code and help us build a repeatable, scalable workflow for how we develop sites.

This role is hands-on. You’ll be building real client websites while also shaping how we do it as a team.


What you’ll do

  • Build production-ready marketing websites and web experiences using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, etc.)
  • Work directly from Figma designs and help define a clean Figma → code handoff process
  • Operate in a fast, iterative “vibe coding” style — rapid prototyping, refining, and shipping
  • Identify patterns across projects and turn them into reusable components, structures, and prompts
  • Help establish a repeatable blueprint for how we build websites with AI (structure, tooling, QA, deployment)
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to continuously improve speed and quality


What we’re looking for

  • 4–5 years of experience in web development / frontend engineering
  • Strong experience as a web engineer / frontend developer
  • Proven ability to ship complete websites (not just components or partial work)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)
  • Comfortable working from Figma and translating designs into clean, production-ready code
  • Solid fundamentals in modern web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frameworks as needed)
  • Ability to move fast, iterate, and make pragmatic decisions
  • Interest in systematizing workflows , not just building one-off projects


Nice to have

  • Experience creating internal tooling, templates, or developer workflows
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Experience working in agency or fast-paced product environments
  • Strong taste in UI implementation and attention to detail


What success looks like

  • You can take a Figma file and turn it into a live, polished website quickly using AI
  • You reduce build time across projects by introducing better workflows and patterns
  • You help turn “vibe coding” into a structured, repeatable system
  • The team can build faster and more consistently because of your contributions


About the role

  • Hands-on engineering role (this is not a pure systems or ops position)
  • High ownership and autonomy
  • Focus on speed, quality, and repeatability

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.
