title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About Signals:

  • Signals is YipitData’s Company Intelligence platform designed to help private equity firms, venture capital investors, finance, and corporate teams identify, diligence, and monitor software and technology companies using alternative data. Signals provides proprietary spend insights on 250K+ companies into a unified web platform, Chrome extension, and data feeds.
  • Customers use Signals to discover emerging companies, validate market trends, conduct diligence with deeper data (including invoice and product-level detail), and monitor portfolio performance using continuously refreshed alternative data


About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Assistente Administrativo & Atendimento (Home Office – Brasil)
description:
Assistente Administrativo e Atendimento (Home Office – Brasil)



Localização: Remoto (Brasil)

Empresa: ORO Stones

Setor: Construção / Fabricação de Superfícies

Sobre a empresa

A ORO Stones é uma empresa especializada na fabricação e instalação de superfícies em pedra natural, quartz e porcelanato, localizada em Orlando, Flórida. Atuamos com projetos residenciais e comerciais, com foco em qualidade, organização e excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um profissional para atuar de forma remota, dando suporte às operações administrativas e ao atendimento da empresa.

Descrição da vaga

Procuramos um(a) Assistente Administrativo e Atendimento para atuar diretamente no suporte às rotinas administrativas e no relacionamento com clientes. Essa posição exige organização, boa comunicação e capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas de forma estruturada.

O profissional será responsável por manter o fluxo de informações organizado, apoiar na elaboração de orçamentos e garantir que o atendimento aos clientes seja conduzido com clareza e eficiência.

Responsabilidades
  • Atendimento a clientes via WhatsApp e e-mail
  • Organização e acompanhamento de leads e clientes
  • Elaboração de orçamentos com base no sistema da empresa
  • Criação e controle de ordens de serviço
  • Apoio na emissão de invoices
  • Organização de pedidos de materiais
  • Atualização de planilhas e sistemas internos
  • Suporte geral às demandas administrativas da empresa
Requisitos
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório)
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e organização
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente ou área administrativa
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente (home office)
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais (Excel, Google Sheets, sistemas)
  • Atenção a detalhes e senso de responsabilidade
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com QuickBooks, Monday ou sistemas de CRM
  • Experiência com empresas internacionais ou clientes nos EUA
  • Experiência no setor de construção, interiores ou reformas
Modelo de trabalho
  • Trabalho remoto (Brasil)
  • Horário comercial dos Estados Unidos (Florida Time)
Como se candidatar
  • Os candidatos devem preencher o formulário de candidatura com atenção. O processo de seleção inclui análise de perfil, avaliação de comunicação e entrevista online.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,800 - $3,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are looking for a Technical Consultant  with a strong mix of technical expertise and problem-solving skills to drive the successful deployment and personalization of our partner's software for their clients. This is a customer-facing, hands-on role  that requires a strong blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, excellent soft skills, and a customer-first mindset.


The ideal candidate possesses the technical capability (particularly with JavaScript and SQL ) to translate defined business requirements into practical software configurations. You must be deeply curious about solving unique technical challenges and skilled at working within our highly configurable platform. This role involves direct system configuration and may include acting as an extension of the client's internal team under our partner's management, demanding excellent communication and adaptability. While not a full-stack development position, it requires more technical capability than a business analyst, with a focus on applying coding and configuration skills to deliver functional solutions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Leverage SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and Excel to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize system functionality.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their specific requirements before writing any code to ensure solutions fully align with business needs.
  • Identify root causes of technical issues before proposing and implementing solutions.
  • Monitor system performance and availability, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
  • Document support activities, issue resolutions, and configuration changes for internal records and customer transparency.
  • Collaborate with consultants, internal teams, and customers to create optimized and scalable solutions.
  • Learn about the company’s highly configurable software system, developing expertise in its unique problem-solving methods.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Technical Consultant, Implementation Specialist, Solution Consultant, or similar roles.
  • Technical proficiency in SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, and Excel.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset and the ability to diagnose root causes before acting.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. 
  • Customer-first approach in finding the best solution for the client.
  • Curiosity and creativity with the ability to think outside the box when tackling complex system configurations. 
  • Learning-first mentality.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in configuration or system analysis for business applications.
  • Experience with business analysis or enterprise software implementation.
  • Background in engineering.
  • Ability to work independently and seek out creative solutions in a constantly evolving environment.


Work Schedule:  EST or later to overlap with European teams


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
Vaga: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect


Modelo: PJ

Período: 1 ano

Local: 100% remoto

Horário: 9h às 18h


Descrição da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Azure Cloud Solutions Architect com sólida experiência em arquitetura, implantação e governança de soluções em Microsoft Azure. Este profissional atuará em ambientes complexos, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e garantindo a construção de soluções robustas, seguras e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Projetar, implementar e otimizar soluções em Microsoft Azure, seguindo melhores práticas de segurança, governança e arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), principalmente com Terraform (módulos, pipelines, gerenciamento de estado).
  • Atuar com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), incluindo deploys via Helm, YAML, e práticas de observabilidade e gestão de contêineres.
  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas seguras com foco em:
  • RBAC
  • Private Endpoints
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Policy as Code
  • Construir pipelines de CI/CD usando Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Projetar soluções orientadas a eventos utilizando Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hub, Kafka e/ou Synapse.
  • Automatizar tarefas usando PowerShell, Bash e/ou Python, com foco em automações via Terraform.
  • Elaborar documentações e diagramas de arquitetura utilizando TOGAF, Diagrams.net ou ferramentas correlatas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento avançado dos principais serviços do Azure (Compute, Network, Storage, Identity, Security, Serverless e Containers).
  • Experiência comprovada com Terraform (módulos, automação, reuso e boas práticas).
  • Domínio de AKS, Helm charts, YAML e práticas de gestão de contêineres.
  • Sólida experiência com segurança e governança em arquitetura de nuvem.
  • Vivência em CI/CD com Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com integrações orientadas a eventos.
  • Scripting avançado (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões arquiteturais (ex.: TOGAF).
  • Inglês avançado.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Azure (AZ-305, AZ-104, AZ-400, etc.).
  • Experiência com FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura híbrida e modelos multi-cloud.

title: .NET Backend Developer Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma consultoria de transformação e inovação digital e buscamos .NET Backend Developer Sênior para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Requisitos e qualificações

- Atuar no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend utilizando .NET 8 e .NET 9

- Desenvolver e manter APIs REST, garantindo documentação adequada com Swagger / OpenAPI

- Implementar e evoluir microsserviços, seguindo padrões de arquitetura

- Trabalhar com Kubernetes, GKE e Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

- Implementar soluções de mensageria utilizando Kafka ou RabbitMQ

- Realizar conteinerização de aplicações utilizando Docker e Kubernetes

- Desenvolver testes unitários utilizando xUnit, NUnit ou MSTest, aplicando técnicas de Mocking

- Utilizar Entity Framework Core para acesso e persistência de dados

  • Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.

title: Designer de Produto
description:
• Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia, e você precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


  • O desafio

Você vai atuar junto de um time de ~20 de Produto (PM, devs, dados) para evoluir a experiência e o produto de ponta a ponta.

Essa não é uma posição para quem usa IA eventualmente. É para quem já incorporou IA no workflow e tem senso crítico para saber quando usar e quando não usar.


  • O que você vai fazer
  • Conduzir pesquisa com usuários (entrevistas, testes, descoberta contínua) e transformar insights em direção clara — usando IA para acelerar síntese e análise de feedback
  • Usar IA ativamente no workflow: geração de variações, rascunhos de stories, análise de dados qualitativos, automação de etapas repetitivas e muito mais
  • Conduzir iterações rápidas de protótipos (do rascunho ao validado) antes de buildar, com apoio de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade sem perder qualidade
  • Manter sistema e consistência na experiência: design system, padrões, acessibilidade e handoff
  • Trabalhar com métricas e experimentação (funil, eventos, testes A/B) para orientar decisões com evidência



  • O que buscamos
  • Uso real de IA no dia a dia de design: Cria workflows, usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Galileo AI ou similares. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito.
  • Maturidade de discovery: Sabe definir problema, hipótese, método certo e chegar em decisão com evidência.
  • Qualidade de escrita: User stories claras, critérios de aceite objetivos e comunicação direta com o time.
  • Senso de produto e negócio (fintech): Entende trade-offs de conversão, retenção, risco e compliance.
  • Sistema e consistência: Experiência com design system, padrões e cuidado com edge cases.
  • Métricas e experimentação: Conforto em acompanhar impacto, instrumentação básica e aprendizado contínuo.



  • O que não buscamos
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar imagens bonitas, sem integrar ao processo de design e descoberta
  • Perfis focados só em execução visual, sem interesse em produto, dados e estratégia
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção e ambientes com ritmo acelerado



  • O que oferecemos
  • 100% remoto | Contratação PJ
  • Remuneração: de R$20k – R$25k a combinar.
  • Autonomia real para evoluir o design do produto
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e disseminar



Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
Vaga: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect


Modelo: PJ

Período: 1 ano

Local: 100% remoto

Horário: 9h às 18h


Descrição da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Azure Cloud Solutions Architect com sólida experiência em arquitetura, implantação e governança de soluções em Microsoft Azure. Este profissional atuará em ambientes complexos, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e garantindo a construção de soluções robustas, seguras e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Projetar, implementar e otimizar soluções em Microsoft Azure, seguindo melhores práticas de segurança, governança e arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), principalmente com Terraform (módulos, pipelines, gerenciamento de estado).
  • Atuar com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), incluindo deploys via Helm, YAML, e práticas de observabilidade e gestão de contêineres.
  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas seguras com foco em:
  • RBAC
  • Private Endpoints
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Policy as Code
  • Construir pipelines de CI/CD usando Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Projetar soluções orientadas a eventos utilizando Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hub, Kafka e/ou Synapse.
  • Automatizar tarefas usando PowerShell, Bash e/ou Python, com foco em automações via Terraform.
  • Elaborar documentações e diagramas de arquitetura utilizando TOGAF, Diagrams.net ou ferramentas correlatas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento avançado dos principais serviços do Azure (Compute, Network, Storage, Identity, Security, Serverless e Containers).
  • Experiência comprovada com Terraform (módulos, automação, reuso e boas práticas).
  • Domínio de AKS, Helm charts, YAML e práticas de gestão de contêineres.
  • Sólida experiência com segurança e governança em arquitetura de nuvem.
  • Vivência em CI/CD com Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com integrações orientadas a eventos.
  • Scripting avançado (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões arquiteturais (ex.: TOGAF).
  • Inglês avançado.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Azure (AZ-305, AZ-104, AZ-400, etc.).
  • Experiência com FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura híbrida e modelos multi-cloud.

title: Senior WordPress Developer (Enterprise CMS / CUE)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to migration projects from enterprise CMS platforms to WordPress , especially newsroom/editorial systems.
  • Design and implement content migration pipelines , including data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL).
  • Work with editorial teams to map content models, taxonomies, and workflows into WordPress.
  • Develop custom plugins and scripts to support large-scale content migrations .
  • Integrate WordPress with APIs from legacy or external CMS platforms.
  • Ensure data integrity, SEO preservation, and minimal downtime during migrations.
  • Optimize WordPress architecture for scalability in content-heavy environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with strong backend focus.
  • Experience with Stibo DX CUE (CUE Platform) .
  • Proven experience in CMS migration projects (any enterprise CMS → WordPress) .
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST APIs.
  • Experience handling large-scale content datasets .
  • Understanding of content modeling, taxonomies, and editorial workflows.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with other enterprise CMS platforms
  • Familiarity with media/publishing environments.
  • Experience with headless CMS architectures.
  • Knowledge of SEO considerations during migrations (URL structures, redirects, metadata preservation).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Data Specialist - Project
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Data Specialist with 5+ years of experience in data analysis, validation, and transformation. This role focuses on reviewing and validating data from multiple sources, ensuring accurate mapping into standardized formats, and maintaining high data quality across pipelines. The ideal candidate has experience working with raw data files, SQL-based systems, and AWS data environments.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance
  • Analyze raw data from clients, devices, and external sources
  • Validate that data is correctly processed, transformed, and stored
  • Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, and data quality issues
  • Ensure outputs match expected results after processing
  • Review and validate data mappings created by engineering teams
  • Ensure raw data is accurately converted into standard formats
  • Collaborate with data engineers to refine and improve mapping logic
  • Take ownership of data quality across systems and workflows
  • Establish and enforce best practices for data validation and integrity
  • Act as a guide for teams to ensure reliable data processing
  • Work closely with data engineering, application engineering, and product teams to ensure alignment on data needs
  • Provide feedback on data issues and recommend improvements
  • Bridge the gap between raw data ingestion and business-ready datasets


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of data validation experience
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on data quality and validation
  • Experience working with structured and semi-structured data
  • Ability to interpret and validate data transformations and mappings
  • Solid understanding of SQL and data querying
  • Experience working in data pipelines or data engineering environments
  • Hands-on experience with data formats such as CSV, JSON, XML, and flat files
  • Familiarity with SQL-compliant databases
  • Exposure to AWS-based data environments
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg and working with event-based or sensor data (e.g., fuel systems, industrial, or IoT data) is a plus.
  • Experience with data platforms such as Apache Iceberg (or similar)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are looking for a Product-Led Marketing & Digital Funnels Manager to own and scale customer acquisition through paid media, webinars, and product-driven marketing funnels for our K-12 solutions.


This role is responsible for building and optimizing full-funnel digital programs from ads to webinars to product demos that generate qualified pipeline and revenue. You will operate at the intersection of product marketing, demand generation, and digital growth, turning interest into engaged prospects and customers through high-performing funnel systems.


Responsibilities

  • Own paid ads strategy across LinkedIn, Google, and retargeting to drive qualified leads
  • Manage and scale webinar programs from promotion through follow-up and conversion
  • Build and optimize digital funnels from ad to landing page to demo or sales opportunity
  • Create and improve landing pages, email nurture sequences, and conversion paths
  • Track and optimize funnel performance including conversion rates, CPL, and pipeline generated
  • Run A/B tests and scale campaigns that consistently generate pipeline


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, demand generation, or funnel management, preferably in K-12, EdTech, or SaaS
  • Proven experience running paid ads, webinars, and digital funnel programs that generate pipeline
  • Strong understanding of product-led marketing and multi-touch buyer journeys
  • Experience with marketing and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Ads, and Google Ads
  • Analytical and results-driven with a focus on conversion and revenue metrics
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: AI Engagement Manager
description:
About Dry Ground AI


Dry Ground AI designs, builds, and maintains AI-powered solutions that accelerate operational velocity for small and mid-sized businesses. Our flagship AI Velocity Plan gives clients a rapid, iterative path from concept to production. You will be the linchpin who keeps those iterations moving forward.



Why This Role Matters


As Engagement Manager, you will own the post-sale customer journey: orchestrating handoffs from Sales to Engineering, driving on-time delivery, and continually identifying new ways to create value. You are part project conductor, part trusted advisor, and part growth catalyst.


Core Responsibilities


Project Leadership

  • Lead multiple AI implementation projects from kickoff through launch and optimization.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, and risk logs
  • Hold engineering and data teams accountable for sprint deliverables, escalate blockers, and manage tradeoffs between scope and schedule.


Customer Success and Relationship Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for a portfolio of AI Velocity and maintenance clients
  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Communicate updates clearly and translate technical milestones into business impact.


Opportunity Expansion

  • Analyze client workflows and data to uncover new AI opportunities.
  • Frame and scope these opportunities as projects to add to the Velocity backlog.
  • Collaborate with Sales to support renewals and upsells.


Process Improvement

  • Improve our delivery playbook, templates, and dashboards.
  • Promote best practices in documentation, change management, and knowledge transfer.



Required Qualifications


  • Fluent English speaking and writing skills. You will run executive meetings and prepare client-facing materials.
  • 5 or more years managing complex software or data/AI projects.
  • Strong experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success, Consulting, or Solutions Delivery.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical teams about APIs, data pipelines, and ML concepts. You do not need to code, but must bridge the gap between business and technical language.
  • Proficient with tools like Notion, Jira, and Asana.
  • Analytical thinker who can read KPIs, prioritize work, and quantify ROI.
  • Employment verification, education verification, and an international background check will be required.
  • Must be authorized to work in your local jurisdiction.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Familiarity with GenAI, LLM tools, or MLOps platforms such as LangChain, Pinecone, or vector databases.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS commercial models.
  • Certifications like PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM are a plus.



What We Offer


  • High-impact role on a fast-moving team building innovative AI solutions.
  • Work from anywhere. We are a fully remote company with clients based in the U.S.
  • Competitive time off and flexible work environment.
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • Training and development support.
  • Work-from-home allowance.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Código da vaga: 59268


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Um desenvolvedor é responsável por escrever código eficiente, resolver problemas técnicos de alta complexidade com autonomia, e colaborar ativamente com outros desenvolvedores do time para a entrega de soluções. Também é desejável a participação em mentorias dos analistas plenos júniores.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Experiência sólida Desenvolver projetos utilizando Java, AWS (Lambda, Step Function, S3, Cloud Watch, Api Gateway, EC2, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS),

Atuação com Kafka, Terraform, GITHUB, Datadog;

Atuação com Inteligência Artificial


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator to lead the management and optimization of our Cloudflare environment and broader cloud infrastructure. This role demands hands-on expertise in Cloudflare services—DNS, WAF, CDN, caching, proxy, and security configurations—to enhance the performance and protection of our global web platforms.


You will also manage cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a strong focus on Linux/Unix systems, automation, observability, and hybrid infrastructure operations.


Key Responsibilities


Cloudflare Administration

  • Manage DNS, WAF, firewall rules, caching, and rate limiting policies
  • Optimize proxy configurations, security settings, and performance features (e.g., Argo, Workers)
  • Mitigate threats (DDoS, bots) and conduct regular audits
  • Maintain documentation and stay updated with new Cloudflare features


Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
  • Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc


System Operations

  • Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
  • Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) issues
  • Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Cloudflare experience in production
  • Strong understanding of Cloudflare WAF, DNS, CDN, caching, and Zero Trust
  • Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDoS mitigation
  • Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL
  • Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Experience

  • 6+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
  • Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Wellhub and Telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.
  • Merit and promotion annual cycle.


And muuuuuuch more!

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.
  • Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs.
  • Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits.
  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
  • Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness.
  • Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms.
  • Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines.
  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).
  • 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems.
  • Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI.
  • Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact).
  • Strong embedded system architecture experience.
  • Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge.
  • Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration.
  • Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs.
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures.
  • Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior Software Engineer (Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica)
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.


What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders


Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

description:

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator to lead the management and optimization of our Cloudflare environment and broader cloud infrastructure. This role demands hands-on expertise in Cloudflare services—DNS, WAF, CDN, caching, proxy, and security configurations—to enhance the performance and protection of our global web platforms.


You will also manage cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a strong focus on Linux/Unix systems, automation, observability, and hybrid infrastructure operations.


Key Responsibilities


Cloudflare Administration

  • Manage DNS, WAF, firewall rules, caching, and rate limiting policies
  • Optimize proxy configurations, security settings, and performance features (e.g., Argo, Workers)
  • Mitigate threats (DDoS, bots) and conduct regular audits
  • Maintain documentation and stay updated with new Cloudflare features


Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
  • Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc


System Operations

  • Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
  • Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) issues
  • Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Cloudflare experience in production
  • Strong understanding of Cloudflare WAF, DNS, CDN, caching, and Zero Trust
  • Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDoS mitigation
  • Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL
  • Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Experience

  • 6+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
  • Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Wellhub and Telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.
  • Merit and promotion annual cycle.


And muuuuuuch more!

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

description:
QA Engineer (Mid-Level)
